segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, the Soddy Line is the central axis passing through the Incenter X one and the Gergonne Point X seven. Extending this line reveals a remarkable incidence: it intersects the Euler line at the de Longchamps Point X twenty.

segments.text: Three mutually tangent circles centered at vertices A, B, and C with radii s minus a, s minus b, and s minus c touch at the exact vertices of the intouch triangle. By Frederick Soddy's nineteen thirty-six theorem, the inner and outer Soddy circles tangent to all three vertex circles have their centers X one-seventy-five and X one-seventy-six on line X one X seven.
